verdict_body: Polymarket's CTF Exchange V2 (April 2026 upgrade) is gated by a custom timelock contract on Polygon at 0x47EbFAC3353314C788B96CDCbf41daadfE03629C with a 12-hour minimum delay verified via the initialization transaction. The contract's non-standard ABI does not expose the OpenZeppelin getMinDelay()/delay()/MIN_DELAY() selectors, so the data pipeline cannot auto-read the value; this sidecar carries the manually-verified delay until PD-042 (governance-fetcher extension) lands. Multisig admin is a 3-of-6 Safe (Protocol Admin, also the timelock's sole proposer/executor/canceller).
